description.en:
Moonring - Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the Moonring, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.

Moonring - Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with Moonring, dealing Aero DMG. Press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3.

Moonbow - Basic Attack

Enter Lunar Cycle - New Moon by casting Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring. When in this state, Iuno will attack with Moonbow.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the Moonbow, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Moonbow - Dodge Counter

When in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with Moonbow, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
When in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonbow - Basic Attack Stage 3.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Moonring - Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun dengan Moonring yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG.

Moonring - Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target dengan Moonring, memberikan Aero DMG. Tekan Normal Attack lagi sesaat setelah melakukan skill ini untuk melancarkan Moonring - Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Moonbow - Basic Attack

Memasuki Lunar Cycle - New Moon dengan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring. Dalam state ini, Iuno akan menyerang dengan Moonbow.
Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun dengan Moonbow yang memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Moonbow - Dodge Counter

Saat dalam Lunar Cycle - New Moon, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target dengan Moonbow, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Saat dalam Lunar Cycle - New Moon, tekan Normal Attack lagi sesaat setelah melakukan skill ini untuk melancarkan Moonbow - Basic Attack Tahap 3.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
Pulse of Origins

Dash forward, dealing Aero DMG.

Closing Refrain

When not in Lunar Cycle, casting Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3, Intro Skill, or Pulse of Origins replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with Closing Refrain for 5s.
Casting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing Aero DMG, and activates Lunar Cycle.

Unfinished Refrain

When in Lunar Cycle - Half Moon, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with Unfinished Refrain.
Casting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing Aero DMG.
Unfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.

Arc Beyond the Edge

When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, her Resonance Skill is replaced with Arc Beyond the Edge, which has 2 initial charges.
Casting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal Aero DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting Arc Beyond the Edge immediately makes her recover from the attack.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Pulse of Origins

Melesat ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.

Closing Refrain

Saat tidak dalam Lunar Cycle, melancarkan Moonring - Basic Attack Tahap 3, Intro Skill, atau Pulse of Origins akan menggantikan Resonance Skill Iuno dengan Closing Refrain selama 5 dtk.
Melancarkan Closing Refrain melepaskan rentetan serangan yang memberikan Aero DMG, dan mengaktifkan Lunar Cycle.

Unfinished Refrain

Saat dalam Lunar Cycle - Half Moon, Resonance Skill Iuno digantikan oleh Unfinished Refrain.
Melancarkan Unfinished Refrain melepaskan rentetan serangan yang memberikan Aero DMG.
Unfinished Refrain memiliki Cooldown yang sama dengan Closing Refrain.

Arc Beyond the Edge

Saat Iuno berada dalam Lunar Cycle - New Moon, Resonance Skill-nya digantikan oleh Arc Beyond the Edge, yang memiliki 2 charge awal.
Melancarkan Arc Beyond the Edge membuat Iuno berpindah posisi dan memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Input arah dapat digunakan untuk memperpanjang jarak perpindahan. Jika Iuno terkena serangan atau terlempar ke udara, melancarkan Arc Beyond the Edge akan langsung memulihkannya dari serangan tersebut.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.id: Setiap kali Iuno melancarkan Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, atau Intro Skill, ia mendapat 1 Shield sebesar 32% ATK-nya selama 15 dtk. Shield ini tidak akan diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.

description.en:
Lunar Cycle

Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain or Resonance Liberation.
Lunar Cycle has two states: Half Moon and New Moon. By default, Iuno enters the Half Moon state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting Heavy Attack - Flux.
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with Heavy Attack - Flux. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air.
- Iuno's movement becomes Meandering, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end Lunar Cycle.

Lunar Cycle - Half Moon

Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring Sentience on hit.
She can use Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow to deal Aero DMG (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to Lunar Cycle - New Moon.
Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow can be cast in mid-air.

Lunar Cycle - New Moon

Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting Moonbow - Basic Attack, Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge, or Moonbow - Dodge Counter consumes Sentience to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring to deal Aero DMG (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to Lunar Cycle - Half Moon.
Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness

When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Absolute Fullness.
Casting Absolute Fullness ends Lunar Cycle, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals Aero DMG to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a Full Moon domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Full Moon Domain

Resonators inside the domain periodically restore HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of Blessing of the Wan Light. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Blessing of the Wan Light

The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

Sentience

Iuno can hold up to 100 points of Sentience.
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of Sentience.
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of Sentience.
Casting Closing Refrain or Unfinished Refrain restores 25 points of Sentience.
When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore Sentience on hit.
description.id:
Lunar Cycle

Iuno dapat mengaktifkan Lunar Cycle dengan melancarkan Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain atau Resonance Liberation.
Lunar Cycle memiliki dua state: Half Moon dan New Moon. Secara default, Iuno memasuki state Half Moon saat mengaktifkan Lunar Cycle dan dapat berganti antara kedua state dengan melancarkan Heavy Attack - Flux.
Saat dalam Lunar Cycle:
- Jump Iuno digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Flux. STA tidak akan pulih saat Iuno berada di udara.
- Gerakan Iuno menjadi Meandering, yang mengonsumsi STA terus-menerus di udara untuk bergerak dengan cara unik.
- Melakukan interaksi lingkungan, menggunakan Utilities, atau menahan Jump akan mengakhiri Lunar Cycle.

Lunar Cycle - Half Moon

Iuno menyerang menggunakan Moonring, memulihkan Sentience saat mengenai target.
Ia dapat menggunakan Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow untuk memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG) dan berganti ke Lunar Cycle - New Moon.
Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Lunar Cycle - New Moon

Iuno menyerang menggunakan Moonbow. Dalam state ini, melancarkan Moonbow - Basic Attack, Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge, atau Moonbow - Dodge Counter akan mengonsumsi Sentience untuk meningkatkan pengali DMG skill, memulihkan tambahan Concerto Energy, dan menyembuhkan Resonator tim di sekitar.
Iuno dapat menggunakan Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring untuk memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG) dan berganti ke Lunar Cycle - Half Moon.
Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness

Saat Concerto Energy Iuno penuh, Heavy Attack-nya digantikan oleh Absolute Fullness.
Melancarkan Absolute Fullness mengakhiri Lunar Cycle, menyembuhkan Resonator tim di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG kepada target di sekitar (dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG), dan memunculkan domain Full Moon di lokasinya. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 25 dtk.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Full Moon Domain

Resonator di dalam domain memulihkan HP dan STA secara berkala.
Mendapat Shield di dalam domain memberikan 1 stack Blessing of the Wan Light. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 0,5 dtk.

Blessing of the Wan Light

Resonator penerima mendapat 4% All DMG Amplify selama 10 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 10 kali. Mendapat stack baru akan me-reset durasi. Efek ini berakhir lebih awal jika Resonator penerima diganti keluar dari lapangan.

Sentience

Iuno dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Sentience.
Melancarkan Intro Skill memulihkan 40 poin Sentience.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation memulihkan 60 poin Sentience.
Melancarkan Closing Refrain atau Unfinished Refrain memulihkan 25 poin Sentience.
Saat Iuno berada dalam Lunar Cycle, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, dan Mid-air Attack memulihkan Sentience saat mengenai target.
